chunks: He said: Al-Sharif Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Hamza reported to me, saying: Ahmad ibn Abdullah narrated to us from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abdullah, who said: My father narrated to me from Dawud ibn al-Nu'man, from Amru ibn Abu al-Miqdam, from his father, from al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon them both) that he said:

Whoever loves us with his heart and helps us with his hand and tongue, he will be with us in the lofty chamber in which we reside. And whoever loves us with his heart and helps us with his tongue, he is one degree below that. And whoever loves us with his heart but withholds his hand and tongue, he will be in Paradise.

key_terms.الغرفة: Al-ghurfa (the lofty chamber): A high station in Paradise, mentioned in Quran 25:75 as the reward of the patient and devout
key_terms.كف: Kaffa (withholds/refrains): To hold back or abstain from active involvement
key_terms.نصرنا: Nasarana (helps us): Active support and defense of the Ahl al-Bayt, both physically and verbally

ai.seo_question: What are the three levels of loving the Ahl al-Bayt according to Imam al-Hasan?
ai.summary: Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali (AS), the second Imam and grandson of Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), addresses the community about three levels of devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt. The highest rank belongs to those who combine sincere love with both physical and verbal support; the middle rank to those who love and speak in their defense; and the baseline reward of Paradise for those who hold love in their hearts even without outward action. This teaching was given in a context where supporters of the Ahl al-Bayt faced persecution, and the Imam distinguished between varying degrees of commitment while affirming that even the minimum of heartfelt love secures salvation.
